result.summary: The page is largely intact and usable. Only minor cosmetic issues are visible: a slightly awkward clipped card in the horizontal carousel and misaligned decorative graphics in the green promo banner.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the third restaurant title ('Trattoria Piccol...') is clipped by the right screen edge, and there is no visible padding or affordance indicating the row continues horizontally.
issues.suggestion: Reduce card width slightly or add right-side padding so the partially visible card's title is less awkwardly cut off, and ensure a clear horizontal-scroll hint.

issues.description: The promo banner's decorative circle graphics are visibly misaligned with the green background, creating an awkward overlapping shape on the right side of the banner.
issues.suggestion: Adjust or clip the decorative shapes so they blend cleanly into the banner background.
